milestones.name: Repository, CI, environment and verified internal catalog
milestones.evidence: Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + TypeScript Strict + Tailwind CSS + Vitest. Canonical catalog and minor poisha pricing models established.

milestones.name: Unified master brand design system (Concept C High-Conversion + Concept A Navy & Gold)
milestones.evidence: Refined single brand experience (Midnight Navy #071525, Champagne Gold #D9B45E, Warm Ivory #FFFCF5) with full dual-language support (English / বাংলা) and clean mobile responsiveness.

milestones.name: Dual Persistence Engine (Disk-backed ACID + Supabase PostgreSQL v3.1.0-PROD)
milestones.evidence: Atomic disk persistence in data/persistent_database.json surviving cold restarts. Complete PostgreSQL migrations (20261108000000_init_schema.sql & 20261108000001_production_schema_v3_1.sql) with multi-tenant RLS.

milestones.name: Dynamic conditional multi-step forms with validated server quote
milestones.evidence: Multi-step wizard at /build. Evaluates Google storefront requirements, Pixel prerequisites, and Meta ban states. Generates SHA-256 terms hashed quote with 7-day TTL.

milestones.name: Auth/business isolation, orders, secure intake, timeline
milestones.evidence: Client workspace at /dashboard and /dashboard/orders/[id]. Visual timeline, SLA clock, zero-password intake form with credential filtering regex, and private file upload dropzone.

milestones.name: Catalog governance, finance, staff assignments, QA, audit logs
milestones.evidence: Admin control center at /admin. Fulfillment queue with specialist assignment, finance manual MFS verification, catalog publication governance, and audit triage.

milestones.name: Provider sandbox, verified callbacks/webhooks, manual reconciliation fallback
milestones.evidence: PaymentProvider interface implemented. SSLCOMMERZ Sandbox adapter with interactive gateway simulator at /checkout/sandbox-gateway. Manual MFS adapter with pending verification.

milestones.name: Policies, security tests, accessibility, review, deployment approval
milestones.evidence: 24 automated Vitest tests passed. Policies published at /policies/terms, /policies/privacy, /policies/refund, /policies/delivery. Production build passes with 103kB shared bundle.
